locations.label: Challenge banners / podium
locations.description: Cut a challenge-banner rope in the Arena with a melee attack. Complete its first three tasks and claim each reward at your podium; the third supplies a Pack-a-Punched Strife, and the central cauldron becomes available for the Acid Trap. Open the four towers, ring each altar-room gong and kill its summoned champion. Carry the four heads to the spikes around the Temple altar to reveal Pack-a-Punch. Danu and Ra share one tower pair; Zeus and Odin share the other. Take the bridges and underground corridors to reach all four altar rooms. Keep your crowd affinity positive until you have the jar for the Orion quest. Deliberately lowering it for Danu first creates extra work. Recommended loadout: a reliable bullet weapon for precise Ra kills, Serket’s Kiss for crowds, and a repaired shield. Dying Wish or Winter’s Wail can protect longer interactions. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Brazen Bull workbench
locations.description: Collect one shield part from each spawn group below, then build the Brazen Bull on the workbench in the back corner of The Pit. Obtain Death of Orion from its quest or the Mystery Box and Pack-a-Punch it into Serket’s Kiss. The shield’s gun is required for the Ra bull targets. Horns, Ra Altar Room: wall between the gong and stairs; pillar beside the Trebuchet wallbuy; or wall beside the zombie window closest to the perk statue. Blade, Zeus tower: Bath House ledge by the stairs; statue’s hand on Entrance level beside the Arena doorway; or statue base on Altar level by the nearby zombie window. Barrels, Odin tower: Cauldron pillar beside the Mystery Box; shield shelf at the top of the Entrance stairs; or around the corner from the Altar stairs. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Skull-grinder search area
locations.description: Three candidate recesses; consult the photographs. After Pack-a-Punch opens, inspect the skull walls in the Temple for the blue-marked skull shown below. Face it, activate your Specialist and interact; collect it from the floor. Put it in the active grinder in Flooded Crypt and fire fully charged Orion shots until it grinds. Take the bone meal from the bottom. Search below all four god emblems; the pillars in front of and behind Pack-a-Punch; both flanking walls; and the skull sections on each side of the upper stair exits. These cover the twelve documented spawn spots. The grinder has three possible positions, all in Flooded Crypt. Check the recessed wall sections around the room. The base Orion takes three fully charged shots; the upgraded version can finish sooner. Watch the grinder and collect its output rather than counting partial-charge shots. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Danu fertilizer ritual
locations.description: Place the prepared fertilizer between the two trees in Danu Tower: Arboretum. This starts a separate wait: allow two full non-special rounds until it emits green smoke. Trigger a Fire Bomb kill with a zombie standing directly over it. Blue cracks in the floor confirm the activation. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Fertilizer bowl
locations.description: Lower crowd affinity to a full red thumbs-down and collect the dung gift the crowd throws into the Arena. Combine dung, bone meal and charcoal in the bowl at Zeus Tower: Bath House. Inspect it after a full non-special round and collect only when the mixture is ready; if it is not ready, allow another round. Running through Arena fire or throwing grenades into the crowd lowers affinity. Retrieve the jar for Orion first if using its quest. Dung costs points on pickup. Confirm you collected the gift instead of only seeing it land. Older walkthroughs budget two full bowl rounds. Readiness in your match is the deciding signal. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
